answer: Proof-of-Stake Sybil Guard. 1) Users lock a small amount of cryptocurrency, like an ember, to create an identity. 2) Malicious actors creating many fake identities must lock increasing amounts for each new identity, forming a canyon of cost. 3) If a fake identity behaves maliciously (e.g., spamming transactions), its locked stake is slashed. Cost per fake identity: 100 tokens. Total cost for N identities: N 100 tokens (linear scaling).
